items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: I understand some people like Betsy Cole, Miss Cole's lawn parties uptown had them every week.

ctx.x: Yeah, well like Red Island, all of us played those lawn parties. That's open in the yard.

I went to about two of them is all I ever went to in my life. Did they ever run them? I understand some people like Betsy Cole, Miss Cole's lawn parties uptown had them every week. But some people, did they just put on a party maybe once a summer and have it a lawn party? Or did people have it regular every week at their house or what?

Well the lawn parties, well it depends. Just like right across the street here. They have in the summertime, they have either fish fry or they have a party with music or you know. And that's the way that people rent your yard or foot-a-law and park. Oh yeah, that's right.
